name: magnus-proof-reader
description: Proof real estate marketing artwork against Flexmls housing details, approved agent contacts, and obvious layout problems.

interface.longDescription: Help real estate graphics teams and marketing reps proof brochures, flyers, postcards, and other listing artwork. Provide the artwork and a Flexmls listing link for each property. Magnus Proof Reader compares printed housing details with the listing, checks agent contact information against approved records or official sources, and flags obvious layout problems. Results include page-specific corrections, housing and contact comparison tables, and unfinished checks. The original graphics request is optional. Listing access, readable artwork, and available web and page-inspection tools are needed for a complete review. Information that cannot be verified is identified for confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Proof this artwork against the Flexmls listing. Check housing details, agent contacts, and obvious layout problems.
Review these brochures and Flexmls links. Also check the requested changes described in the attached original request.

publication.release_notes: Add the Magnus Title website and privacy policy to the public listing.
